facts.text: An operator-in-the-loop simulator consists of a cab, screens and controls where a real person drives a simulated machine, allowing human reactions to warnings and automatic braking to be measured.
facts.quote: An operator-in-the-loop simulator is a cab, screens and controls where a real person drives a simulated machine, so that human reactions to warnings and automatic braking can be measured.

facts.text: Machine simulators can study operator warning reaction time, surprise caused by a sudden automatic stop, and the number of nuisance stops tolerated before switching the system off.
facts.quote: The same equipment can be used to study behavior: how long an operator takes to react to a warning, whether a sudden automatic stop surprises them, and how many nuisance stops they will tolerate before switching the system off.

facts.text: The booklet names the Fraunhofer ITWM RODOS human-in-the-loop driving simulator as an operator-in-the-loop simulator option.
